icons.MC: 12 vertices in ne_10m — a heptagon, indistinguishable from SM and NR. mapsicon: 285.
icons.SM: 19 vertices in ne_10m. mapsicon: 229, and the notch at Serravalle is back.
icons.LI: 26 vertices in ne_10m — readable, but the Rhine border is a straight line. mapsicon: 166.

noShape.TV: Nine atolls over 676 km of ocean; D-8 keeps the largest, which is a 13-vertex sliver of Funafuti. Not in mapsicon either. Keeps its flag, capital and GDP challenges.
noShape.MH: Same shape of problem as TV: 29 atolls, and D-8 leaves a 17-vertex speck. Not in mapsicon. Keeps its other three kinds.
